001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.chocosolver.memory.IStateBitSet;
005import org.chocosolver.memory.IStateInt;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
009import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.IntVar;
010import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.events.IntEventType;
011import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
012
013/**
014 * Enforces no path from one node to another.
015 *
016 * @author jimmy
017 */
018public class PropUnreachable extends Propagator<IntVar> {
019
020    private final int from;
021    private final int to;
022    // The end of the path.
023    private final IStateInt position;
024    // All the nodes that reach the end node.
025    private final IStateBitSet toComponent;
026
027    /**
028     * Enforce no path from one node to another. {@code edges[i] = j} implies
029     * that there is a directed edge from node i to node j.
030     * {@code edges[i] ≥ edges.length} implies that there are no direct edges
031     * from node i.
032     *
033     * @param edges the edges
034     * @param from the start node
035     * @param to the end node
036     */
037    public PropUnreachable(IntVar[] edges, int from, int to) {
038        super(edges, PropagatorPriority.TERNARY, true);
039        if (from < 0 || from >= vars.length) {
040            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
041        }
042        if (to < 0 || to >= vars.length) {
043            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
044        }
045        this.from = from;
046        this.to = to;
047        this.position = edges[0].getEnvironment().makeInt(from);
048        this.toComponent = edges[0].getEnvironment().makeBitSet(edges.length);
049        this.toComponent.set(to);
050    }
051
052    @Override
053    public int getPropagationConditions(int vIdx) {
054        return IntEventType.instantiation();
055    }
056
057    @Override
058    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
059        if (from == to) {
060            fails();
061        }
062        vars[from].updateLowerBound(0, this);
063        vars[from].removeValue(to, this);
064        for (int i = 0; i < vars.length; i++) {
065            if (vars[i].isInstantiated() && !isPassive()) {
066                follow(i);
067            }
068        }
069    }
070
071    private void remove(IntVar var, IStateBitSet remove) throws ContradictionException {
072        for (int i = remove.nextSetBit(0); i >= 0; i = remove.nextSetBit(i + 1)) {
073            var.removeValue(i, this);
074        }
075    }
076
077    private void follow(int follower) throws ContradictionException {
078        assert vars[follower].isInstantiated();
079        int leader = vars[follower].getValue();
080        if (position.get() == follower) {
081            int cur = leader;
082            if (cur < 0) {
083                fails();
084            }
085            int i;
086            for (i = 0; i < vars.length && cur < vars.length && vars[cur].isInstantiated(); i++) {
087                if (toComponent.get(cur)) {
088                    fails();
089                }
090                cur = vars[cur].getValue();
091                if (cur < 0) {
092                    fails();
093                }
094            }
095            if (toComponent.get(cur)) {
096                fails();
097            }
098            if (cur >= vars.length || i == vars.length) {
099                setPassive();
100            } else {
101                vars[cur].updateLowerBound(0, this);
102                remove(vars[cur], toComponent);
103                position.set(cur);
104                if (vars[cur].isInstantiated()) {
105                    follow(cur);
106                }
107            }
108        } else if (leader < vars.length && !toComponent.get(follower) && toComponent.get(leader)) {
109            toComponent.set(follower);
110            vars[position.get()].removeValue(follower, this);
111            if (vars[position.get()].isInstantiated()) {
112                follow(position.get());
113            }
114            for (int i = 0; i < vars.length && isActive(); i++) {
115                if (vars[i].isInstantiatedTo(follower)) {
116                    follow(i);
117                }
118            }
119        }
120    }
121
122    @Override
123    public void propagate(int idxVarInProp, int mask) throws ContradictionException {
124        follow(idxVarInProp);
125    }
126
127    @Override
128    public ESat isEntailed() {
129        // Hopefully escape analysis will make these boolean arrays cheap.
130        boolean[] visited = new boolean[vars.length];
131        int cur = from;
132        while (cur < vars.length && vars[cur].isInstantiated() && !visited[cur]) {
133            visited[cur] = true;
134            if (cur == to) {
135                return ESat.FALSE;
136            }
137            cur = vars[cur].getValue();
138            if (cur < 0) {
139                return ESat.FALSE;
140            }
141        }
142        return cur >= vars.length || vars[cur].isInstantiated() ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
143    }
144
145    @Override
146    public String toString() {
147        return "unreachable(from=" + from + ", to=" + to + ", " + Arrays.toString(vars) + ")";
148    }
149}
